title: Audio Memo Notified Event
description: One decision of the car's speech arbiter about something it says aloud for a memo: the instant acknowledgement on Stop & Send, the 'heard' echo of the transcript, a progress update, or the reply itself, being queued, started, ended, deferred (a recording is in progress), dropped (stale or superseded) or interrupted (a recording started). Reported by the device through the upload proxy (/upload/client-event, event 'speech'), so the order and overlap of everything spoken on the device can be audited from the server. Part of the voice memo journey: correlationid = data.memo_id and ordering_key 'memo:<memo_id>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

s3_key.description: The memo's inbox key when the device sent it.

utterance.description: What was (to be) spoken: ack | heard | progress | reply, or another device word.

decision.description: What the arbiter did: queued | started | ended | deferred | dropped | interrupted | stopped | failed, or another device word.

utterance_id.description: The device's id for the utterance (ties queued/started/ended together).

device_at.description: When the decision happened on the device's clock (RFC 3339).

since_stop_ms.description: Milliseconds since the recording was stopped, measured on the device (the acknowledgement latency on an ack).

recording.description: Whether a recording was in progress (or arming) at the decision.
